title: Uneven gains in protein-RNA affinity and mutation-effect prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.24739v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate matched affinities determine mutation effects, but gains in aggregate affinity prediction may transfer unevenly to average effects, ordering and local accuracy. We evaluated eleven method families using method-specific matched populations. Controlled CoPRA reduced absolute-affinity mean absolute error from 1.2898 to 1.1431 pKd. Across 220 mutation pairs from 20 families, it generated stronger responses and improved mean-effect accuracy, with uncertain ranking gains and no decrease in mean centered local error. In an independent external test (24 quantitative pairs from three source-matched families), absolute and ordinary mutation-effect errors fell in all three families. Mean centered local error fell from 0.4198 to 0.3761 pKd, with improvements in two families and higher error in one. Error decomposition localized gains in landscape means. translated_title: 蛋白质-RNA亲和力与突变效应预测中的不均衡收益
translated_abstract: 准确的匹配亲和力决定突变效应，但总体亲和力预测的收益可能不均衡地传递到平均效应、排序和局部准确性上。我们使用方法特定的匹配数据集评估了十一类方法。受控的CoPRA将绝对亲和力的平均绝对误差从1.2898降低到1.1431 pKd。在来自20个家族的220对突变中，它产生了更强的响应并提高了平均效应准确性，但排序收益不确定，且平均中心局部误差没有降低。在一项独立的外部测试中（来自三个来源匹配家族的24对定量数据），绝对突变效应误差和常规突变效应误差在所有三个家族中均有所下降。平均中心局部误差从0.4198降至0.3761 pKd，其中两个家族有所改善，一个家族误差更高。误差分解将收益定位于结合景观的均值上。PRA-Pred的特征追踪、固定权重的M2-PRNet输入控制以及匹配监督……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究系统评估了11类蛋白质-RNA亲和力预测方法，发现总体亲和力预测的进步并不均衡地转化为突变效应预测的收益——受控CoPRA降低了绝对亲和力误差、提升了平均效应准确性并在独立外部测试中全面改善，但排序准确性和局部误差的收益参差不齐。
en_tdlr: Systematic evaluation of eleven protein-RNA affinity prediction method families reveals that aggregate affinity gains transfer unevenly to mutation-effect prediction, with controlled CoPRA reducing affinity and mean-effect errors and improving external generalization, while ranking and local accuracy gains remain inconsistent.
